decision.reason: [ev-dac3a3c51ce8] clearly states the subject (the Docker provider static option providers.docker.tls.caOptional, shown in YAML, TOML and CLI form) and the change (removed in v3). It also gives the remediation: delete the option from static configuration. The open aspect is the consequence, and the excerpt never says what happens to an environment that leaves the option set: whether Traefik fails to start, rejects the configuration, or ignores the option. The excerpt is also cut off mid-remediation, so evidence about runtime behaviour, such as static-config parsing or a changelog note on unknown keys, is needed to decide the consequence.
